tldr: Mercury in the 10th house: thinking becomes personal through career, visibility, reputation, authority, ambition, and public direction.
body:
With Mercury in the 10th house, this part of you works through career, visibility, reputation, authority, ambition, and public direction. Mercury describes thinking, communication, learning, writing, and the way the mind makes connections. In practice, this brings attention to the work, responsibilities, goals, and public roles that shape how you are seen.

When this placement is supported, your direction can become more visible, accountable, and real. Mercury can become clear language, strategy, curiosity, problem-solving, and the ability to name what is happening.

When it is strained, achievement or approval can start carrying too much of your identity. The harder pattern can show up as overthinking, nervous loops, clever avoidance, or talking around what needs to be said.
gift: clear language, strategy, curiosity, problem-solving, and the ability to name what is happening expressed through career, visibility, reputation, authority, ambition, and public direction.
challenge: overthinking, nervous loops, clever avoidance, or talking around what needs to be said around career, visibility, reputation, authority, ambition, and public direction.
